day_summary_reputation_desc: Higher reputation attracts more customers and increases the chance they’ll be high-spending.
gameplay_death_desc: You're not giving up just yet but your store has been raided.
gameplay_death_hardcore_desc: As this is a hardcore save, you can no longer respawn.
gameplay_no_news_warning: There is currently no news to listen to.
gameplay_notification_customer_died_insi: A customer has died inside your shop! Move the body before others see it.
gameplay_notification_customer_died_outs: A customer has died in the nearby vicinity outside of your shop. If left too long, more zombies may be attracted.
gameplay_notification_exotic_merchant: The exotic merchant has arrived outside the car park for the day. Check out his rare wares when you get a chance.
gameplay_notification_landmark_liberated: {[LANDMARK]} has been defeated. Open the world map to claim your reward!
gameplay_notification_mission_complete: Contract complete, good job! A reward has been delivered outside the store.
gameplay_notification_raiders: Beware! A group of deadly raiders have been spotted approaching the store.
gameplay_notification_staff_death: {[NAME]} has been killed on the job. Do not expect them to return to work tomorrow.
gameplay_notification_staff_delivery: {[NAME]} has delivered a package outside the store!
gameplay_notification_thief: An item has been stolen from the store. If you're quick you may be able to catch them!
gameplay_staff_assign_task: Select a location to work at…
gameplay_staff_cancel_job_warning: Are you sure you want to cancel the current job? You will not be refunded.
gameplay_staff_cleaner_desc: Cleaners will keep on top of the mounting dead bodies in the store, as well as organising fallen items onto shelves.
gameplay_staff_combat_desc: This worker will head towards the designated location and help fight the cause. Combat missions are somewhat of a health and safety risk, having an increased chance of death.
gameplay_staff_crafting_desc: Crafters will automate the process of creating new stock by repurposing old stock. They will need an empty and accessible crafting station to work on.
gameplay_staff_defeated_last_job_warning: The landmark has already been defeated.
gameplay_staff_fire_staff_warning: Are you sure you want to fire {[STAFF_NAME]}? This cannot be undone.
gameplay_staff_home_desc: Sending workers home can be a cost-effective way to keep them safe during raid days. They'll still want their base pay rate.
gameplay_staff_invalid_last_job_warning: This staff member's last job is invalid.
gameplay_staff_medical_desc: Medical staff will treat and monitor ill-fated and injured people.
gameplay_staff_no_job_hint: Select a job from the list to see more information.
gameplay_staff_no_last_job_warning: This staff member has no last job to reassign.
gameplay_staff_options_cleaner_0_desc: Can loot and dispose of corpses.
gameplay_staff_options_cleaner_1_desc: Can dispose of corpses in the Shredder (when operational).
gameplay_staff_options_cleaner_2_desc: Will fetch items from the outside and attempt to organise them according to your placements.
gameplay_staff_options_not_valid: The current job settings prevent the staff member from doing any job!
gameplay_staff_options_security_0_desc: Guards stationary in the store. Beware: One star guards have questionable aim and can kill friends unintentionally.
gameplay_staff_options_security_3_desc: Climbs the water tower nearby and scouts the outside carpark, sniping any threats. (Requires Sniper Rifle)
gameplay_staff_options_security_4_desc: When no threat nearby will refill secured Mountable Turrets and Auto Miniguns when their ammo is low.
gameplay_staff_options_service_0_desc: Purchases items sold to the store at market price or below.
gameplay_staff_options_service_1_desc: When not serving customers, the worker will stack basket items back on the nearest basket stand.
gameplay_staff_options_service_2_desc: Has a chance to convince a customer to purchase more items after a successful transaction.
gameplay_staff_options_service_3_desc: Will empty basket items with contents on to the floor before placing them back on to a basket stand.
gameplay_staff_options_service_4_desc: Will retrieve secured items for customers when not serving at a Service Desk.
gameplay_staff_options_world_0_desc: Allows purchasing multiple items from world shops in a single trip.
gameplay_staff_options_world_1_desc: Choose 1 item from the chosen landmark to increase the chance of scavenging it.
gameplay_staff_scavenge_desc: Scavengers will spend their shifts scouring a set location on the world map. Once their inventories are full with potentially useful items they'll deposit them back at the shop.
gameplay_staff_security_desc: Security workers will risk their lives protecting the store from threats including zombies, thieves and raiders.
gameplay_staff_select_hint: Select a job above to assign to this staff member.
gameplay_staff_send_home_warning: Are you sure you want to send this worker home for the day? They will return tomorrow as usual.
gameplay_staff_service_desc: Service workers will take away the monotany of serving customers by doing it for you. Service workers must have an empty and accessible checkout to serve from.
gameplay_staff_shop_desc: You have selected a merchant for your worker to visit in the world. Once there the worker will purchase the requested item(s) and deliver it back to the store.
gameplay_staff_shop_out_of_stock_warning: The shop no longer has the same items in stock.
gameplay_staff_weapon_rarity_warning: Staff do not know how to use this weapon. They can train it in the skill tree.

item_storage_flimsy_wooden_shelf_desc: Used to display items on the shop floor. Shelved items have a higher chance of purchase.
item_storage_high_value_cabinet_desc: Customers must request the cabinet be opened before taking the items inside. Good prevention for theiving customers.
item_storage_long_secure_shelf_desc: Customers must request the cabinet be opened before taking the items inside. Good prevention for theiving customers.
item_storage_long_weapon_rack_desc: Increases the purchasing chance of all weapons and ammo placed on this shelf.
item_storage_pallet_desc: Store multiple of the same item with ease.
item_storage_refrigerator_desc: A rare luxury in these times. Increases the purchasing chance of all food items placed inside.
item_storage_secure_shelf_desc: Customers must request the cabinet be opened before taking the items inside. Good prevention for theiving customers.
item_storage_secure_table_desc: Customers must request the cabinet be opened before taking the items inside. Good prevention for theiving customers.
item_storage_special_item_unit_desc: Dramatically increases the chance a customer will view and purchase the items shelved here.
item_storage_supermarket_shelf_desc: Reclaimed supermarket aisle shelving. Increases the chance a customer will visit items placed here.
item_storage_supermarket_shelves_desc: Reclaimed supermarket aisle shelving. Increases the chance a customer will visit items placed here.
item_storage_supermarket_unit_desc: Reclaimed supermarket aisle shelving. Increases the chance a customer will visit items placed here.
item_storage_weapon_rack_desc: Increases the purchasing chance of all weapons and ammo placed on this shelf.
item_survival_gas_can_desc: A tub filled with flammable gasolene.
item_survival_propane_tank_desc: A heavy container filled with propane. Extremely explosive!
item_survival_sleeping_bag_desc: Makes sleeping rough just that little bit easier.
item_throwable_bone_desc: A common sight these days, despite this, zombies just cannot seem to get enough of them.
item_throwable_molotov_cocktail_desc: Highly flammable throwable item. Creates a flammable area upon impact.
item_throwable_nail_bomb_desc: Tin Can + Nails + Explosives = Punctured Foes
item_tool_crowbar_desc: A common tool used to craft. Can also be fashioned into a weak melee weapon.
item_tool_hammer_desc: A common tool used to craft. Can also be fashioned into a weak melee weapon.
item_tool_laser_cutter_desc: A common tool used to craft. Can also be fashioned into a weak melee weapon.
item_usage_explodes: Explodes shortly after contact, causing {[DAMAGE_VALUE]} damage at the center.
item_usage_lures: Lures nearby zombies within a {[LURE_RADIUS]} meter radius.
quest_assign_job: Assign a job to the new staff member.
quest_bed: Rest for the night in your bed.
quest_city_gates: Pay the city guard {[VALUE]} batteries to gain access to the city via the World Map (<rewiredElement playerId=0 actionName="OpenMap">).
quest_close_store: Close the store by clicking the entrance switch.
quest_craft_item: Craft an item at the crafting station by placing required items on the table.
quest_craft_items: Craft x{[AMOUNT]} items for Crafting XP.
quest_defeat_birther: Send staff to defeat the Broody Birthers, gaining deeper access to the city.
quest_defeat_brute: Send staff to defeat the Brute Army, gaining deeper access to the city.
quest_defeat_raid: Successfully defend a zombie raid against your store.
quest_defeat_sweaty_rotter: Send staff to defeat the Sweaty Rotter, gaining deeper access to the city.
quest_defeat_twins: Send staff to defeat the Twin Terrors, gaining deeper access to the city.
quest_demolition_crew: Expand the store by hiring the demolition crew.
quest_donate_to_diner: Donate the requested resources to the Diner Clan to gain access to their shop.
quest_equip_melee_weapon: Equip your currently held melee weapon.
quest_equip_staff: Increase a staff member's combat power by giving them a new weapon. Hold the weapon in Interact Mode (<rewiredElement playerId=0 actionName="Item1">) and interact to give.
quest_extract_blood: Extract blood at the Blood Station. This will cost Max HP for the day.
quest_find_recipe: Break the boxes in the warehouse to find a crafting recipe.
quest_fix_bridge: Fix the Collapsed Bridge by obtaining the required resources.
quest_fix_door: Repair the front door via Build Mode <rewiredElement playerId=0 actionName="Item2">.
quest_fix_shredder: Obtain enough Sawblades to fix the shredder.
quest_fix_siren: Fix the Siren by the road via Build Mode <rewiredElement playerId=0 actionName="Item2">.
quest_free_hulk: Free the 'cured' hulking zombie using the Chainsaw.
quest_fuel_generator: Provide the generator with some gas via Build Mode <rewiredElement playerId=0 actionName="Item2">.
quest_give_blood: Grab a blood syringe from the Blood Station and give it to the Almost-Turned Zombie.
quest_grab_container: Pick up the cardboard box container.
quest_grab_item: Put an item into the cardboard box.
quest_hammer: Find and equip the hammer in the store.
quest_heal_infected_customer: Heal an infected customer using The Cure.
quest_learn_bandages: Learn to craft bandages via the Crafting skill tree (<rewiredElement playerId=0 actionName="OpenSkills">).
quest_learn_medium_crates: Learn to craft Medium Crates via the Crafting skill tree (<rewiredElement playerId=0 actionName="OpenSkills">).
quest_level_up_crafting: Level up the Crafting skill by crafting more items.
quest_level_up_staff: Level up a staff member's job rating by overpaying them double while they work on that job.
quest_listen_radio: Listen to the radio when it beeps to learn about approaching zombie raids.
quest_notes_scavenge1: Outside the store: keep an eye out for full duffle bags, junk piles, and abandoned trolleys. In a panic people leave so many sellable goods.
quest_notes_scavenge2: Its a chaotic world now. The outside restocks itself - new stashes seemingly show up overnight.
quest_notes_scavenge3: Grab fast, sort later. Great for when you are running low on stock!
quest_notes_upgrade1: I used to run this place with love, but I had to leave in a hurry - so excuse the mess!
quest_notes_upgrade2: If you’re reading this, you found something to pry the latch. Nice work.
quest_notes_upgrade3: Use that same energy in Build Mode via <rewiredElement playerId=0 actionName="Item2">. From there you can upgrade various objects in the bedroom with the right materials.
quest_notes_upgrade4: This room kept me alive. Make it better. Make it yours. Hopefully the rest of the pages are still intact for more tips.
quest_notes_warehouse1: Crafting bench, tools, and all my good ideas are in the warehouse.
quest_notes_warehouse2: You’ll need a Crowbar for the door. Sadly I had to throw mine at a horde of zombies climbing through the bedroom window.
quest_notes_warehouse3: Proceed carefully: we blocked that door for a reason.
quest_open_hospital: Unlock the Heavy Door and investigate the old hospital.
quest_open_store: Open the store for business by clicking the entrance switch.
quest_open_warehouse: Obtain a Crowbar to open the bolted door.
quest_play_wheel: Give Dr. Gib Good Meat to play his wheel of fortune!
quest_scavenge_outside: Find and search {[TOTAL]} loot caches over several days. {[PERCENT]}
quest_scavenger_delivery: Open a package delivered by a scavenger worker.
quest_send_staff_shop: Assign a staff member to purchase an item from Thom's Toolshed on the world map.
quest_set_item_price: Set the price of the item.
quest_shelve_item: Place an item on a shelf using the container.
quest_shred_bodies: Throw corpses into the Shredder to receive Good Meat.
quest_skill_tree: Unlock any skill node in the Skills tree (<rewiredElement playerId=0 actionName="OpenSkills">).
quest_start_generator: Obtain a Taser Stick to kick start the generator.
quest_trash_disposal: Dispose of trash into the outside skip. {[PERCENT]}
quest_unlock_bunker: Obtain x{[AMOUNT]} Nail Bombs to explode the underground bunker open.
quest_upgrade_bedroom: Upgrade any object in your bedroom using Build mode (<rewiredElement playerId=0 actionName="Item2">).
quest_upgrade_crafting_station: Upgrade the Crafting Station via Build Mode <rewiredElement playerId=0 actionName="Item2">.
quest_upgrade_radio: Take a Low-Frequency Radio to the table in the bedroom to upgrade it using Build mode (<rewiredElement playerId=0 actionName="Item2">).
quest_use_build_mode: Use build mode to move and place this item.
quest_use_build_mode_repair: Use build mode to repair this object.
quest_zombie_horde: Send staff to defeat the zombie horde, gaining further access to the city.
skill_node_12_gauge_ammo_desc: Unlock the ability to craft 12-Gauge shells for shotguns.
skill_node_556mm_ammo_desc: Unlock the ability to craft 556mm ammo for guns such as assault rifles and LMGs.
skill_node_762mm_ammo_desc: Unlock the ability to craft 762mm ammo for sniper rifles.
skill_node_9mm_ammo_desc: Unlock the ability to craft 9mm ammo for pistols.
skill_node_after_hours_xp_desc: Earn bonus Service XP the longer the store remains open.
skill_node_arrows_desc: Unlock the ability to craft arrows that can be fired from bows and crossbows.
skill_node_auto_minigun_desc: Unlock the ability to craft autonomous threat-seeking miniguns.
skill_node_bandage_desc: Unlock the ability to craft bandages.
skill_node_barbed_wire_desc: Unlock the ability to craft a barbed wire defence item.
skill_node_better_recycling_desc: {[VALUE]}% more Service XP when disposing objects in a skip.
skill_node_body_disposal_xp_desc: Disposing of {[VALUE_PARAM]} dead bodies grants {[VALUE2_PARAM]} bonus XP.
skill_node_bone_dagger_desc: Unlock the ability to craft makeshift daggers using bones and metal.
skill_node_bone_revolver_desc: Unlock the ability to craft a modded pistol using bones for longer range.
skill_node_buyers_market_desc: Reduce the price of an item being sold to the store by {[VALUE]}%.
skill_node_checkout_sales_bonus_diy_desc: Increases sales of all crafting and survival items by {[VALUE_PARAM]}%.
skill_node_checkout_sales_bonus_food_des: Increases sales of all food and medicine items by {[VALUE_PARAM]}%.
skill_node_checkout_sales_bonus_gun_desc: Increases sales of all guns and ammo by {[VALUE_PARAM]}%.
skill_node_checkout_sales_bonus_melee_de: Increases sales of all melee weapons and throwable items by {[VALUE_PARAM]}%.
skill_node_cleaner_desc: Allow staff to work clean up corpses and organise items.
skill_node_cleaner_loot_bonus_desc: Cleaners have a {[VALUE_PARAM]}% chance to find an extra item when looting.
skill_node_cleaner_pickpocket_desc: Cleaners with nothing to clean may pickpocket customers.
skill_node_cure_reputation_desc: Gain {[VALUE_PARAM]}% more reputation when curing infected customers.
skill_node_customer_impulse_buy_desc: Increases the chance customers will buy items by {[VALUE_PARAM]}%.
skill_node_customer_patience_desc: Customers are willing to wait an extra {[VALUE_PARAM]} minutes in a queue before leaving.
skill_node_dilemma_foresight_desc: Dilemmas presented by staff in the world show a success percentage.
skill_node_dismantle_desc: Unlock the ability to dismantle known items for {[VALUE]}% of their craft materials.
skill_node_doctor_gib_meat_cost_desc: Reduces meat cost for Doctor Gib’s game by {[VALUE_PARAM]}%.
skill_node_doctor_gib_rarity_desc: Increases item rarity rewards from Doctor Gib’s game.
skill_node_double_craft_chance_desc: Crafting has a {[VALUE_PARAM]}% chance to produce double items.
skill_node_double_storage_crate_desc: Unlock the ability to craft double storage crates for storing items inside.
skill_node_dual_shelving_unit_desc: Unlock the ability to craft Dual Shelving Units.
skill_node_exotic_merchant_early_desc: The Exotic Merchant appears {[VALUE_PARAM]} days sooner.
skill_node_exotic_merchant_stock_desc: Increases the Exotic Merchant’s item count by {[VALUE_PARAM]}.
skill_node_firework_rpg_desc: Unlock the ability to craft fireworks that can be used in rocket launchers.
skill_node_flamethrower_desc: Unlock the ability to craft an incinerating flamethrower.
skill_node_gold_digger_desc: Increased chance to find rarer items while looting corpses.
skill_node_haggling_desc: Enable price haggling when serving customers at the checkout.
skill_node_healed_gift_bonus_desc: Healed customers give {[VALUE_PARAM]} more items in their gifts.
skill_node_last_resort_desc: Become invincible for 5 seconds at 1% HP (60 second cooldown).
skill_node_lift_with_your_legs_desc: Increase carrying capacity of all containers by {[VALUE]}%.
skill_node_march_order_desc: Reduce travel time of world jobs by {[VALUE]}%.
skill_node_market_expert_desc: Display market value of a new item being sold to the store.
skill_node_medium_storage_crate_desc: Unlock the ability to craft medium storage crates for storing items inside.
skill_node_modded_nail_gun_desc: Unlock the ability to craft a modded nail gun, allowing it to fire nails automatically.
skill_node_molotov_cocktail_desc: Unlock the ability to craft throwable molotovs that cause an area of fire upon impact.
skill_node_mountable_turret_desc: Unlock the ability to craft turrets that can be operated by yourself or security guards.
skill_node_pallet_desc: Unlock the ability to craft pallets that can stack many of the same items on top.
skill_node_pickpocket_desc: Unlock the ability to pickpocket customers.
skill_node_priority_scavenging_desc: Unlock the ability to specify previously looted items from scavenger missions to be prioritised.
skill_node_public_relations_desc: Reduce reputation penalty when a customer dies in store by {[VALUE]}%.
skill_node_raid_bonus_loot_desc: Defeating a raid grants {[VALUE_PARAM]} extra items.
skill_node_rapid_rummaging_desc: Increase searching and looting speed by {[VALUE]}%.
skill_node_regeneration_desc: Heal {[VALUE]}HP every second while not in combat.
skill_node_remote_bomb_desc: Unlock the ability to craft bombs that can be remotely detonated.
skill_node_remote_incendiary_desc: Unlock the ability to craft incendiary explosives that can be remotely detonated.
skill_node_repair_desc: Unlock the ability to repair damaged items.
skill_node_repeat_craft_xp_desc: Crafting {[VALUE_PARAM]} of the same item in a row grants {[VALUE2_PARAM]} bonus XP.
skill_node_resourcefulness_desc: While crafting, each material has a {[VALUE]}% of not being consumed.
skill_node_safety_first_desc: Earn {[VALUE]}% more XP when over {[THRESHOLD]}% max HP.
skill_node_saw_launcher_desc: Unlock the ability to craft a bulky weapon that can launch penetrating sawblades.
skill_node_sawblade_club_desc: Unlock the ability to craft deadly weighted clubs with a razor-sharp sawblade head.
skill_node_security_desc: Allow staff to become security guards, keeping the store safe from threats.
skill_node_service_desc: Allow staff to work on service desks autonomously serving customers.
skill_node_service_desk_desc: Unlock the ability to craft Service Desks.
skill_node_shady_dealings_desc: The black market van will now visit atleast every {[VALUE]} days.
skill_node_shop_discounts_desc: Reduces all world shop prices by {[VALUE_PARAM]}%.
skill_node_shop_stock_bonus_desc: Increases all world shop stocks by {[VALUE_PARAM]}%.
skill_node_shredder_double_output_desc: Shredder has a {[VALUE_PARAM]}% chance to output double items.
skill_node_slat_crate_desc: Unlock the ability to craft slat crates that are larger containers than cardboard boxes.
skill_node_spike_wall_desc: Unlock the ability to craft a spiked wall defence item.
skill_node_spiky_bat_desc: Unlock the ability to craft bats with nails.
skill_node_sprint_desc: Unlock the ability to sprint, increasing movement speed by 50% for 10 seconds.
skill_node_staff_combat_power_desc: Increases all staff combat power by {[VALUE_PARAM]}%.
skill_node_staff_infection_immunity_desc: All staff are immune to infection.
skill_node_staff_potential_desc: Increases daily potential staff approaches by {[VALUE_PARAM]}.
skill_node_staff_xp_rate_desc: Increases staff XP gain rate by {[VALUE_PARAM]}% when a staff member is Happy.
skill_node_storage_crate_desc: Unlock the ability to craft small storage crates for storing items inside.
skill_node_throw_items_desc: Enable the ability to throw held items in Interact mode.
skill_node_tougher_workforce_desc: Staff less likely to die while out on world jobs.
skill_node_upselling_desc: Customers have a chance to browse again after successfully purchasing an item.
skill_node_weapon_rack_desc: Unlock the ability to craft weapon rack shelving that increases the purchasing chance of weapons and ammo placed on them.
skill_node_weapon_rarity_unlock_desc: Unlocks the ability to wield higher rarity weapons.
skill_node_wooden_spear_desc: Unlock the ability to craft aero-dynamic wooden spears, great for ranged combat.
skill_node_word_of_mouth_desc: {[VALUE]}% increased reputation per sale with fair pricing.
skill_node_wrenchblade_desc: Unlock the ability to craft a blade with a pipe wrench handle.
upgrade_improvement_bookshelf: Place books to passively earn skill XP overnight.
upgrade_improvement_ceiling_fan: Dramatically calms customers in the room.
upgrade_improvement_ceiling_fan2: Increases purchasing chance of the room.

Can craft with items within a 3 meter radius.
Can automatically craft the same item until all requirements used.

Can craft with items anywhere in the warehouse.
upgrade_improvement_foldable_sign: Increases customers in the morning and evening.
upgrade_improvement_generator: Fill the generator to be one step closer to opening the back door.
upgrade_improvement_rusty_basket_stand: Can stack Cardboard Boxes for shoppers to purchase multiple items.
upgrade_improvement_shortwave_radio: Notifies up to 3 days before a raid.
upgrade_improvement_shredder: Breaks down objects outputting 50% of their base materials
upgrade_improvement_siren: Brings a revealed raid forward to tomorrow.
upgrade_improvement_sturdy_basket_stand: Can stack Slat Crates and Shopping Baskets for shoppers to purchase even more items.
world_landmark_abandoned_arcade_desc: A building once solely dedicated to fun past-times.
world_landmark_birther_boss_desc: Send staff members here to clear a path. The better their Combat Power the higher chance at success.
world_landmark_boat_desc: It appears the infection breached international waters. The potential for exotic items here is high.
world_landmark_broken_bridge_desc: Who knows how this happened. Perhaps with enough materials we can find a way across.
world_landmark_broken_bridge_info0: We can use any of the requirement materials we have back at the store to fix the bridge. Let's hope its worth our while!
world_landmark_brute_boss_desc: Send staff members here to clear a path. The better their Combat Power the higher chance at success.
world_landmark_car_salesman_desc: A handful of 'legitimately sourced' vehicles. Great for speeding up workers performing world jobs.
world_landmark_church_desc: God's plan seems to have gone slightly off the rails, just like the fanatics in this church.
world_landmark_city_gates_desc: Permanent armed guards are stationed here. There must be some way we can gain access…
world_landmark_city_gates_info2: What's in here? The city's got traders, food, and weapons - everything folks die for out there.
world_landmark_city_gates_info3: Psst… Come closer. You want in for good? It’ll cost you. Pay up, and the gates stay open for you... permanently.
world_landmark_demolition_crew_desc: A ragtag group of born ex-handymen, at your service for all your destructive needs!
world_landmark_demolition_crew_info1: Heard you're lookin' to bust out a wall, huh? We can do that - me and the lads’ve opened up tighter spots than this.
world_landmark_demolition_crew_info2: We roll in at 9AM sharp, no delays. But here's the deal - if anything jumps out at us, shots fired, infected show up, whatever - we drop the tools and walk. No arguments. No refund
world_landmark_diner_desc: This clan of survivors want a package of weapons and equipment to prove our loyalty and trustworthiness.
world_landmark_diner_shop_desc: The clan, happy with our donations, are eager to trade with us.
world_landmark_drop_dead_docks_activate_: Are you sure you wish to activate this contract? You may only have one contract active at one time.
world_landmark_drop_dead_docks_desc: Somewhere between a trade post and a tetanus hazard, meet unusual people with unusual requests. Fulfill Emergency Contracts to earn rare items and curiosities.
world_landmark_drop_dead_docks_info0: Sketchy operators here would like you to disrupt the local market. Activate a contract and sell the required goods in your store before time runs out to earn a rare reward.
world_landmark_drop_dead_docks_info1: Completing a contract will unlock a new one. You may only have one contract active at one time.
world_landmark_drop_dead_docks_info2: Completing a contract will unlock a new one. You may only have one contract active at one time.
world_landmark_drop_dead_docks_reroll_wa: Are you sure you wish to reroll all inactive contracts? Any active contract will not be rerolled.
world_landmark_exit_tunnel_desc: The finish line for many but an opportunistic shelter for others.
world_landmark_farm_desc: Going back to basics is really the only way to survive in this new landscape. Lets take advantage.
world_landmark_farm_sabotage_desc: Burning the city's only stable food supply is ethically terrible, but, could prove financially incredible.
world_landmark_florist_desc: A budding florist looking to bring some hopefulness and life to these dark times.
world_landmark_garage_desc: An arsenel of tools, makeshift weapons and crafting knowledge.
world_landmark_hospital_desc: No longer taking appointments, but, if we need any medical supplies surely this would be the place to check.
world_landmark_hunting_store_desc: If this place was still in service they'd make a killing!
world_landmark_jewelers_desc: No sign of love or life. Perhaps we may find some value in the furniture.
world_landmark_junkyard_desc: Pallets full of good quality crafting goods. They appear to be watched by the workers so caution is advised.
world_landmark_mobile_news_crew_desc: A small team of reporters happy to advertise around the city for a cost.
world_landmark_mobile_news_crew_info0: Need to shift a lot of stock in a hurry? Spread the word about your stock and get more customers in your store fast.
world_landmark_motel_desc: Behomoth zombies have locked down the area. Defeat them for a hefty reward.
world_landmark_nuclear_plant_desc: This plant has been dormant for sometime. However, will a little explosion, we could really disrupt our clientele's needs.
world_landmark_outer_city_depots_desc: Tucked away outside the city limits. Hopefully they've been forgotten about.
world_landmark_quarantine_zone_desc: The first military intervention attempt at the city. There are still armed guards here making this incredibly high risk high reward.
world_landmark_supermarket_desc: Once bustling with shoppers, now a decaying husk - ripe for scavenging, but not without danger.
world_landmark_sweaty_boss_desc: Send staff members here to clear a path. The better their Combat Power the higher chance at success.
world_landmark_toolshed_desc: A scrappy yet wholesome 'yard-sale' ran by a DIY expert. NEW STOCK DAILY!
world_landmark_trailer_park_desc: These guys have been prepping for this their entire lives, somehow becoming the elite society.
world_landmark_twins_boss_desc: Send staff members here to clear a path. The better their Combat Power the higher chance at success.
world_landmark_zombie_horde_defeated_des: Breath in this brief victory… We've managed to defeat the zombie horde.
world_landmark_zombie_horde_desc: Send staff members here to clear a path. The better their Combat Power the higher chance at success.
world_landmark_zombie_horde_info0: Further access to the city will be available in coming updates! Thank you for your patience.
